title: Lumineer
description: Giving players control over light as a building material.
body:
Lumineer Brings Tons of new lights and blocks for your minecraft world!

Lumineer currently includes imbedded lighting variants for core stone materials:

- Imbedded Stone & Cobblestone
- Imbedded Deepslate & Cobbled Deepslate
- Imbedded Deepslate Bricks & Tiles
- Imbedded Andesite, Diorite, Granite
- Imbedded Polished Stone Variants
- Imbedded Calcite
- Imbedded Tuff

  🚧 This Mod Is Just Getting Started
